messages:
Marin: Quick check — trying to calibrate model onboarding gate scores for new candidates. Current rubric feels too permissive.
Ben: Which metrics are we weighting too low? latency? eval pass rate?
Carla: Prob eval pass + regen regression. We're seeing models with +0.5% rouge but huge hallucination counts in the safety eval.
Marin: Right. Proposal: bump safety eval weight to 30%, quality (ROUGE/avg) 25%, perf (p50 latency + mem) 20%, infra risk (quant friendliness) 15%, docs/ops readiness 10%.
Tariq: Can we make infra risk split: 10% quantization, 5% decoding memory footprint? quant often causes 3-5% quality delta.
Lina: I'd prefer a hard gate on quant delta: if quantized model exceeds 2.0% relative drop on our core evals, it fails onboarding. Soft score tweaks shouldn't override that.
Ben: Agree to hard gate for quant delta. Also add a canary rollout checklist item: 1000 live tokens for 24h with golden prompts, monitor top-line latency and end-to-end error rate.
Carla: For canary we should auto-fallback to hosted small model if error rate > 1% or latency p99 > 1200ms.
Marin: OK. Action items:
- Ben: update scoring YAML schema and add hard gate field (due EOD)
- Lina + Tariq: run quant sweep on current top candidates with our 4-bit and 8-bit recipes (due 48h)
- Carla: add golden prompt set + alert thresholds to the canary playbook (due tomorrow)
DevOpsBot: Deploy job queued: quant-sweep/top-candidates (id: q-2109). Estimated runtime: 12h.
Tariq: Noted. One note — we should document acceptable perf vs cost tradeoff. Some customers prefer latency over cost; maybe tag candidates with SLO profile.
Marin: Good point. Add 'preferred_slo' metadata field when submitting intake.
Lina: Also, let's record model-variance fingerprint: sample of 500 prompts, store token-level perplexity distribution. Could help catch flaky outputs.
Ben: I'll add fields to the intake form: preferred_slo, sample_fingerprint_link, quant_gate_passed:true/false.
Carla: Quick question — are we keeping old 'score cutoff 70' rule? That cliff causes churn. Maybe we switch to '70 recommended, but require passing hard gates'.
Marin: Exactly. Soft cutoff 70 -> recommendation. Hard gates as above. We'll trial for two weeks and re-evaluate.
Tariq: Sounds good. If anyone needs the scoring proto, ping me and I'll share the branch.
Marin: Thanks all. Ping @here tomorrow 10am for a short calibration huddle if everyone can join. :calendar:
Lina: I'll be there. :+1:
Ben: thumbs up
Carla: :raised_hands:
DevOpsBot: Job q-2109 started (ETA 11h).
